name: Goliath Clan Upbringing

benefits.name: Gol-Kaa
benefits.description: Learn Gol-Kaa, the traditional language of many older Goliath clan communities. This learned language is not an inherited Species trait.

benefits.name: Clan Training
benefits.description: Choose one Skill training from Athletics, Insight, or Survival. Training in composite Athletics does not automatically train its independently ranked Climb, Jump, or Swim components.

benefits.name: Clan Craft
benefits.description: Choose one Competency from Cooking, Leatherworking, or Navigation, reflecting practical community traditions.

reviewNotes: The Goliath Clan clan tradition can be chosen by any Species.
Original 3.5e Goliaths used Gol-Kaa; later 5e Goliaths used Giant. These are distinct languages.
The Giant cultural Upbringings are independent selections rather than children of this record.
No feat, rune spellcasting, ancestral powers, or automatic Ordning allegiance is granted.
The Gol-Kaa language-catalog definition is future work; the language grant is a coherent first-pass entry.
